assessment_kind: maintainer threat model; not independent security certification

threats.control: Local/device-only processing and internal service isolation
threats.residual: Redaction misses, host compromise and untested covert channels remain possible

threats.control: Loopback binding, bearer authentication and origin/body/concurrency rejection
threats.residual: Stolen tokens and local malware can invoke the local gateway

threats.control: No proxy/redirect credential forwarding in the manual checker
threats.residual: A compromised owner host can read its credentials

threats.control: Escaped rendering, response identity and isolated content-script tests
threats.residual: A vendor page can imitate or remove UI; shadow roots and unsigned records do not authenticate origin

threats.control: Hash-locked packages and pre-load model asset verification
threats.residual: Trusted-image compromise, floating base-image changes and incomplete SBOM/signing remain open

threats.control: Input handled as data; development command/use-mention regressions
threats.residual: Development examples are not independent accuracy evidence; supported patterns are limited

threats.control: No default upload/persistence; minimal export with separate detailed consent
threats.residual: Explicit detailed export can link input through hashes/positions; private corpus is deliberately owner-held persistent data

threats.control: Revision/race regression checks and unsupported-route visibility
threats.residual: Broad live vendor changes/regeneration remain unverified; MAIN-world capture is inactive scope

threats.control: Polite compact controls, keyboard and automated accessibility checks
threats.residual: Human screen-reader, physical-phone and independent usability acceptance remain open

threats.control: CSP, no-transform and exact public artifact comparison
threats.residual: Hosting/DNS providers remain dependencies and receive connection metadata; hashes do not defeat a compromised trusted build
